observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha-branded electronic keyboard with full-size keys and a purple control panel/display area.
Photo 1 shows the front of the keyboard with the large 'YAMAHA' logo on the body and two orange/black side speaker grilles.
Photo 2 shows the keyboard from a closer angle; the 'YAMAHA' logo is visible on the front, and the control panel/display area is present but the exact model number is not readable.

claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model/spec level (e.g., arranger/workstation vs entry model) and condition are not verifiable from these images; no model number is readable.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is not readable, so the price could be wrong (different models vary a lot in value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and the full front panel model text if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic Yamaha electronic keyboard of unknown model (worst-case value for an older/entry unit).

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (keys, sound, speakers, display/backlight, buttons/knobs).
risks.proof: Short video showing: power on, working display, playing multiple keys, changing sounds, and volume/speaker output (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested / worst-case not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Physical condition not fully confirmed (scratches, broken knobs/buttons, loose casing, missing parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: control knobs/buttons, headphone/USB/power ports, and any visible damage points on the casing.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as used with possible cosmetic wear and potential minor defects.

risks.risk: Power adapter/required accessories may be missing or incompatible.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact power adapter (label/ratings) and confirmation of included accessories (stand, sustain pedal, cables).
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming essential accessories may be missing.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number/label (back/underside) so we can price the exact Yamaha model.
Video test: power on + display, play keys across the range, change presets/sounds, and show speaker output (or headphone output).
Photos of ports and included accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, any cables/stand).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model and working condition are not verifiable remotely; without the model label and a basic functionality test, a correct worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
